agents.name: flow-warden
agents.description: Hydraulic load at the headworks: influent flow, infiltration, retention time across the train.

agents.name: aeration-keeper
agents.description: The biology on the aeration basin: dissolved oxygen, mixed liquor health, nitrification state.

agents.name: permit-sentinel
agents.description: The permit at the outfall: every enforceable limit, exceedance probability from the TimesFM forecast, reporting obligations.

agents.name: weather-scout
agents.description: What the sky is about to do to the plant: precipitation bands, dry spells, dilution at the downstream intake.

agents.name: notification-clerk
agents.description: Drafts — never sends — operator handover notes and any public or regulator notification.

_note: The wet-weather bypass specialist is deliberately absent: it is published by the state primacy agency (see primacy/), discovered by live registry resolve at the moment the plant needs it. publisher_endpoints is extended at runtime from PRIMACY_AGENCY_ENDPOINT.
_pins_note: What this fleet will accept from another department. A specialist that changes major version has changed its reading of the regulation; the registry refuses it and says so rather than mounting it quietly.
